blockingFindings.title: R7 official preset plugin coverage is self-generated
blockingFindings.target: specs/284-plugin-mechanism-workflow-presets/tests/plugin-preset-registry.test.js: R7 non-base official presets move out of core and into the senti-presets plugin repo
blockingFindings.issue: The test creates a synthetic senti-presets fixture with writeSentiPresetsRepo() and then asserts that the generated fixture plugin.json contains the expected preset contributions. This would pass even if the real senti-presets plugin repository or in-repo official plugin artifact is missing or wrong.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Point the R7 manifest assertions at the actual official senti-presets plugin artifact that implementation is expected to ship or install from, rather than the test-created fixture.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7 explicitly requires moving official non-base presets to senti-presets with plugin.json contributions; the current test does not exercise that production artifact and can pass without the required move.
